tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description:
Publicly quotable gross prices (incl. 19% German VAT) for storage products
        (20ft containers in Eltville-Martinsthal & Walluf; indoor storage boxes and Euro pallet places in Eltville-Martinsthal only)
        and online-bookable services (Halteverbot / no-parking zone, furniture lift rental).

tools.name: create_inquiry
tools.description: Submit a moving/transport/storage quote inquiry to Schlingloff Euromovers. Reply within 24h on business days. Max 10 inquiries/hour. For an accurate quote include in message: desired move date, origin and destination addresses, floor/elevator, approximate volume or room count.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_pricing" is 686 chars, far longer than this server's median (133). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "get_pricing" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet:
before: "Publicly quotable gross prices (incl. 19% German VAT) for storage products
        (20ft containers in Eltville & Walluf, indoor storage boxes, Euro pallet places)
        and online-bookable services (Halteverbot / no-parking zone, furniture lift rental).
        Optional category filter: storage_c" → after: "Publicly quotable gross prices (incl. 19% German VAT) for storage products
        (20ft containers in Eltville-Martinsthal & Walluf; indoor storage boxes and Euro pallet places in Eltville-Martinsthal only)
        and online-bookable services (Halteverbot / no-parking zone, furniture lift rental)."

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
